notes: Starting as posted under 'Starting (7)' lists eight cards: Agents in court/ No love for the empire, Jp Audience Chamber, Tatooine Hutt Trade Route, Podrace Prep, Ani's pod, podrace arena, boonta eve, Uh-oh. All eight count; with them the deck totals 60.
The representative is Kabe (per the strategy), deployed from the Characters section; no rep is listed among the starting cards.

Posted 'Oromoko' dested Orrimaarko; 'Tesseek' dested Tessek; 'Leia w/ gun' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han w/ gun' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Chewie protector' dested Chewbacca, Protector; 'Projection' dested Projection Of A Skywalker.

Posted 'Tat jabba's palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (Special Edition); 'Tat judland waste's' dested Tatooine: Jundland Wastes (Official Tournament Sealed Deck), the only Light printing; 'Tat cantina' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tatooine Hutt Trade Route' dested the Light Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert).

Posted 'Nar shadda wind chimes/ out of somewhere' and 'sorry about the mess/ Blaster pro' dested the Reflections II combo interrupts; 'Obi's saber', 'Ani's saber' and 'Obi's journal' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, Anakin's Lightsaber and Obi-Wan's Journal.
The strategy also mentions I Did It!, Kessel and Goo Nee Tay, which are not in the posted list.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 26 July 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.
